_help: Website-only settings, matched by category name (or Ledger id). 'blurb' is the one-line description, 'seo_name' the search-friendly name used in page titles, 'icon' an SVG path. 'order' sets the order; 'hide_services' lists service IDs to keep off the site. A new category with no entry here still shows, with a default icon.
